notes: Single source of truth for the bounded DSV4 PP8 resident production envelope. Materialized topology/runtime/KV JSON files must match this file. This profile is first-three co-resident survival mode after live Qwen+Gemma+DSV4 startup at 4 seqs/2048 tokens/1GiB KV loaded successfully but drove spark2 below the 10% available-RAM floor, after a 2 seqs/1024 tokens/512MiB KV launch exposed first-run FlashInfer/CUDA compiler RAM pressure on sparks 4-6, and after live all-three post-request telemetry showed sparks 4-6 below the 10% available-RAM floor. It caps DSV4 at 2 active sequences, 1024 batched tokens, 512MiB resident/offload KV per rank, 0.08 GPU utilization, retunes DSV4 layers as 5/6/6/7/4/4/4/7, skips the SM121 DeepGEMM pre-JIT warmup that can hit gemm.hpp:99 before serving, pins sparse MLA prefill to the batch-qualified indexed Triton backend, forces DSV4 PP sampled-token NCCL broadcasts onto IPv4 sockets over ds4ring0 instead of RoCE QPs, and requires a DSV4-only warmup before all-three residency.
